narration: One price that moves almost everything else. Oil is one of the five commodities on Meme Street. In the real world, it powers transport and industry around the globe. Demand comes from fuel for cars, ships and lorries, jet fuel for flights, and plastics and chemicals. It's used in transport, flights and plastics, so when oil moves, costs ripple through the whole economy. What makes it different is that supply shocks can move it very fast. What can push it down? A slowing economy, extra supply, and inflation data that changes the outlook. On Meme Street, data and headlines hit the news wire, and the price reacts. Trade oil at memestreet.net.
